# Northpointe Announces Quarterly Common Stock Dividend Increase


October 06, 2026 4:15 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_cd9f01cc503cc62064d73a768c4e3dae/northpointe/news/2026-10-06_Northpointe_Announces_Quarterly_Common_Stock_127.pdf)


GRAND RAPIDS, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Northpointe Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: NPB), the holding company of Northpointe Bank, announced today that its Board of Directors has declared an increase in the quarterly cash dividend to $0.03 per common share, a 20% increase from the previous quarterly cash dividend of $0.025 per common share. The dividend is payable on November 4, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 15, 2026.


**About Northpointe Bancshares, Inc.**


Headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Northpointe Bancshares, Inc. is the holding company of Northpointe Bank, a client-focused company that provides home loans and retail banking products to communities across the nation. Our mission is to be the best bank in America by bringing value and innovation to the people we serve. To learn more visit[www.northpointe.com](http://www.northpointe.com/) .
